stem:
In a species of snail, shell colour is controlled by a gene with three alleles:
• allele $C^B$ codes for a brown shell
• allele $C^P$ codes for a pink shell
• allele $C^Y$ codes for a yellow shell.

Allele $C^B$ is dominant to both $C^P$ and $C^Y$.
Allele $C^P$ is dominant to $C^Y$.

The shells of this snail may be banded (have dark stripes) or non-banded.
The allele for non-banded, $N$, is dominant to the allele for banded, $n$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by the terms *dominant* and *allele*.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: A cross between a brown, non-banded snail and a pink, non-banded snail produces some offspring that are both yellow **and** banded.
parts.text: State the genotypes of both parents.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: State the genotype of the offspring that are both yellow **and** banded.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Suggest the proportion of offspring expected to be both yellow **and** banded.
